data.name: Mp4Dialog_FFmpegMessage
data.value:
To use MP4 to GIF conversion, you need to install FFmpeg first.
Easy installation using Windows Package Manager: 1. Open Command Prompt or PowerShell as Administrator 2. Run: winget install ffmpeg 3. Restart this application
Alternative methods: • Download from: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html • Or use Chocolatey: choco install ffmpeg
After installation, FFmpeg should be available in your system PATH.
